in_marathi.name: Apsita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apsita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Apsita is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is the name of a goddess, often referred to as the goddess of rain. She is believed to bring nourishment and life-giving rain to the earth. In Hindu mythology, she is sometimes depicted with a pot of water, symbolizing her role in providing sustenance.
